summary: OpenAI released an updated version of its Agents SDK adding native sandbox execution and a model-native harness for building agents that operate across files and tools.

mechanisms.reason: The update targets building secure, long-running agents that operate across files and tools, which is the agentic workflow pattern.
mechanisms.quote: helping developers build secure, long-running agents across files and tools

mechanisms.reason: Long-running agents that operate across many tools and files imply more inference calls per task than single-turn chat.
